title: Alleged Threats Against A Clerk In The Employ Of Samuel Osborn And Company Ltd.

page_data.en:
5.1
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL REGISTRY
No. 1433
Date 21 / 2 42
Central
Misc.142/42 February 20th.,1942.

ALLEGED THREATS AGAINST A CLERK IN THE
EMPLOY OF SAMUEL OSBORN & CO. LTD.

At 4.15 p.m. 19-2-42 a telephone message was
received at station from Mr. Scott-Finn, British, manager
of Samuel Osborn & Co., 149 Yuen Ming Yuen Rd. reporting
that one of his clerks named Tsang Ung Foh (張恩福) was
in danger of being attacked by three ex-coolies of the
company.
C.D.S. 335 and the undersigned attended the above
company and ascertained the following:

Since 8-12-41 the company has been in a very
difficult position to carry on its business and so, on
10-1-42 the manager paid three months salary to his staff
consisting of two clerks and three coolies, with the
option of resigning immediately or remaining until the
end of March when the company would probably be suspended
Objections were raised by the coolies at first but after
an explanation by Clerk Tsang Ung Foh of the difficult
condition encountered by the company they all accepted
the three months salary. However, the coolies named
Tsang Ah Foh (張阿福), Loh Ah Nyi (陸阿二) & Yang Wu Ching
(楊武清) hold grudge against the clerk, accusing him of
having received more allowance from the manager.

On the morning of 19-2-42 the clerk received from
his friend information that the coolies who had not re-
turned to office for the past few days were going to do
harm to him (the clerk) when returning home.

The manager and the clerk have been told by de-
tectives to inform Police at once should any of the
coolies come to the office again or be seen on the road
Enquiries proceeding.
Copy to Special Branch.
Lung Shao Lane
D. S. I.

（左侧批注及印章）

5.1
上海公共租界工部局警务处
特别登记处
第 1433 号
日期 42 年 2 月 21 日

中央
杂项 142/42 1942 年 2 月 20 日。

据称对山茂洋行有限公司（Samuel Osborn & Co. Ltd.）一名职员进行威胁一事。

1942 年 2 月 19 日下午 4 时 15 分，巡捕房接到圆明园路 149 号山茂洋行有限公司英籍经理 Scott-Finn 先生的电话报告，称其一名名为张恩福（Tsang Ung Foh）的职员正面临被该公司三名前苦力袭击的危险。

刑事侦缉处第 335 号警员及本人前往上述公司，查明情况如下：

自 1941 年 12 月 8 日以来，该公司经营陷入极大困境，因此，经理于 1942 年 1 月 10 日向全体员工（包括两名职员和三名苦力）支付了三个月薪水，并允许他们选择立即辞职或留任至三月底，届时公司可能会停业。起初苦力们提出异议，但在职员张恩福解释了公司所面临的困难处境后，他们都接受了三个月的薪水。然而，名为张阿福（Tsang Ah Foh）、陆阿二（Loh Ah Nyi）和杨武清（Yang Wu Ching）的苦力对该职员怀恨在心，指责他从经理那里获得了更多的津贴。

1942 年 2 月 19 日上午，该职员从朋友处得知，过去几天未回办公室上班的苦力打算在他回家时加害于他（该职员）。

侦探已告知经理和该职员，若有任何苦力再次来到办公室或在路上被发现，应立即通知警方。调查正在进行中。
抄送特别科。
龙少兰（音译）
副督察长

（左侧批注及印章）
51
Bl
